application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of external materials (3), SuDS (15) and construction traffic management plan (16) of planning permission ref: 25/02646/FUL due to insufficient information pertaining to external materials and the submitted construction traffic management plan as well as an unacceptable Drainage Strategy which fails demonstrate sufficient drainage. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy CP24, CP28 of the Core Strategy, Policies D4, T7, SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and Policy DMD6, DMD8, DMD37, DMD49, DMD61 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/02646/FUL: external materials (3), landscaping (4), energy statement (5), dust management plan (10), SuDS (15) and construction traffic management plan (16) in respect of erection of a pair semi-detached two storey dwellinghouses with accommodation in roof space and rear and front dormers.
